code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}sub-business-categories`;const getSubBusinessCategories=async()=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL);return response.data;};const deleteSubBusinessCategory=async subbusinesscategoryId=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+subbusinesscategoryId);return response.data;};const updateSubBusinessCategory=async(subbusinesscategoryId,subbusinesscategoryData)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+subbusinesscategoryId,subbusinesscategoryData);return response.data;};const createSubBusinessCategory=async subbusinesscategoryData=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,subbusinesscategoryData);return response.data;};const batchDeleteSubBusinessCategory=async subbusinesscategoryIds=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",subbusinesscategoryIds);return response.data;};const subbusinesscategoryService={createSubBusinessCategory,getSubBusinessCategories,deleteSubBusinessCategory,updateSubBusinessCategory,batchDeleteSubBusinessCategory};export default subbusinesscategoryService;
